summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $38.16 million registered direct offering of Class A shares to Mapie Wind Limited, an existing investor, under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated August 7, 2026. The structure is a pre-paid purchase facility: Mapie funds up to $36 million (with 6% OID), receiving an outstanding pre-paid amount of $38.16 million, settled via share issuance at a price equal to the lower of 50% of the closing price on the agreement date or 50% of the lowest closing price over the prior 180 trading days, subject to a $0.10 floor. The initial pre-paid purchase was $3.498 million. Interest accrues at 7% annually, increasing to 18% on default, with mandatory cash settlement at 120% of outstanding at maturity in two years. Univest Securities is exclusive placement agent. This is a structured equity line/convertible-like financing; watch for potential dilution and overhang from discounted share settlements.
